Congress Alleges Government Hid Information on Operation Sindoor Martyrs

The Congress party has accused the government of hiding information regarding martyrs of 'Operation Sindoor'. The government has denied these claims, stating they are incorrect. The opposition party has also demanded the resignation of the Defence Minister, alleging he misled Parliament. The Ministry of Defence has issued clarifications on the matter.
